cohort: Frozen 32 stations from station_pilot_packages/20261016T200304Z-7c2377e9/cohort.json; no outcome-based reselection
origin_grid: Hourly UTC, forecast issue time is the cutoff; observations strictly before it
boundary_rule: All four future target observations must precede partition end; origin plus 180 minutes plus 120-second label tolerance is purged at boundaries
target_definition: First actual station poll at or after issue+horizon, no more than 120 seconds later; observed rentable bike and usable dock counts. Point-in-time risk, not risk of any shortage anywhere in the preceding interval.
population: Fresh, installed stations accepting both rentals and returns at issue and target; no interpolation through missing endpoint data. Future closures are censored and counted, not labeled empty/full. Conditional on continued service.
geography: Previous-day information assumed available after day-end plus one hour; provider timestamp also before issue. UUID/short-name unique; location stable within 25m of prior and frozen cohort. Known missing identities invalidate mappings; metadata expires after 49 hours.
features: Station index, current bikes/docks/ebikes/disabled counts, dated capacity, calendar and horizon. Optional lag observations are stored for audit/future work but excluded from this first predictor allowlist so live scoring does not require unavailable historical lags. No future trips, target status or target configuration used as predictors.
labels_available: Timestamp of target poll; no monthly trip-release lag because outcomes are directly observed GBFS inventory, not monthly trip counts
selection: Count candidate chosen separately for bikes/docks by August 1-14 validation MAE, persisted before September evaluation; selected learners refit through August 14. No post-calibration refit.
risk_model: Fixed histogram gradient boosting classifier with 15 leaves; fit through August 14. Predict zero rentable bikes and zero usable docks separately. Sigmoid calibration per outcome and horizon on August 15-31, constant calibrated prevalence if no class variation.
intervals: Nominal 90% split-conformal absolute residual intervals per outcome/horizon from August 15-31; lower bound truncated at zero, no unsupported hard capacity clipping. Report September empirical coverage and width. Time dependence and drift prevent unconditional coverage guarantees.
metrics: MAE and RMSE versus persistence by horizon
Brier score and average precision versus persistence and historical prevalence
deployment: Separate versioned Free Edition training and manual-refresh dashboard. Snapshot timestamps and stale/offline states visible. No changes to active departure models or existing recurring jobs.
limitations: Retrospective reconstructed observations; exact daily metadata publication is assumed
Targets conditional on continued station service and fresh endpoint coverage
Observed inventory includes unidentified operator/maintenance effects
Predicts inventory, not attempted demand or optimal movements
Uncertainty calibration may drift outside its historical window
No weather or subway predictors in this first direct-inventory model
